visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length dark hair and a black turtleneck sits cross-legged on a white faux-fur rug. In front of her is a massive light blue rectangular box with 'GENTLE MONSTER JEWELRY' printed in black. Behind her, a white bed and a framed black and white 'BAUHAUS' poster are visible. She smiles brightly while gesturing towards the box. (2) She lifts the top of the blue box to reveal a luxurious dark velvet interior holding a large, ornate silver scepter. The scepter features a heart-shaped top adorned with a large central pearl, smaller surrounding pearls, and pink gemstones. She carefully lifts the heavy object, rotating it to show the intricate metalwork and the ring-like setting at its peak. (3) Next, she presents a pair of silver-framed glasses heavily encrusted with white pearls and pink gems along the rims and temples. She places them on her face, adjusting her hair. A small picture-in-picture graphic appears showing a black pair of sunglasses with a teddy bear charm. She then demonstrates how the pearl glasses can be connected to form a necklace. (4) She holds up a multi-tiered display tray from the box containing four more pairs of eyewear and a white case. She picks up a pair of slim silver glasses with small star-shaped crystals on the lenses. She strikes various poses, tilting her head to show the side details consisting of double rows of pearls. (5) The woman showcases two more minimalist silver frames, one with a pink jewel on the hinge and another rimless design with three small pearls. Finally, she wears a pair of thick black rectangular sunglasses with a silver jewel embellishment on the side. She speaks directly to the camera with high energy and expressive hand movements. (6) She displays a white, hexagonal-shaped hard case with the 'GENTLE MONSTER' logo engraved on the front. She holds it close to the lens to show its textured finish and sharp geometric lines. The lighting remains bright and even throughout, highlighting the reflective surfaces of the jewelry and eyewear.
